I want to change the delivery address for my laptop to my NYC address, and I also want to change the laptop specs and exchange my watch for a different color dial, but keep the same strap. Sorry, I’m a bit sad and just want to get this sorted together.

Thank you for understanding. I actually don’t remember my email right now, but my name is Yara Silva and my zip code is 77159. I hope that’s enough. I just want to get these changes done together, if that’s okay.

Thank you for helping me with this. I’d like the laptop to have an i5 processor, 256GB SSD storage, and be in space grey. For the watch, I want to exchange it for one with a black dial but keep the leather strap.

I’m a bit cautious about sharing my address, but it should already be saved in my orders profile as my NYC address. Could you please use that one? I just want to make sure everything is handled safely and together.

Yes, that’s all correct. Please go ahead and change the delivery address and laptop specs for my pending order, and exchange my watch for the black dial version with the leather strap. Thank you for handling everything together—I really appreciate it.

Thank you for letting me know. I understand about the watch—I’ll wait until it’s delivered before we do the exchange. For now, I don’t have any other requests. Please notify me when the watch is eligible for exchange. Thanks for helping me with everything together.
Thank you so much for your help and understanding. I appreciate you taking care of everything together. Have a good day. ###STOP###
